struct MaxFlow {
    struct Edge {
        int from, to;
        long long flow, capacity;
    };
    int s, t;
    vector<Edge> edges;
    vector<int> graph[7100];
    int dist[7100], visited[7100], current[7100];

    void initialize() {
        edges.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < 7100; ++i) {
            graph[i].clear();
        }
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, long long cap) {
        Edge e1 = {from, to, 0, cap};
        Edge e2 = {to, from, 0, 0};
        edges.push_back(e1);
        edges.push_back(e2);
        graph[from].push_back((int)edges.size() - 2);
        graph[to].push_back((int)edges.size() - 1);
    }

    bool buildLevelGraph() {
        memset(visited, 0, sizeof(visited));
        memset(dist, 0, sizeof(dist));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(s);
        visited[s] = 1;
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int v = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[v].size(); ++i) {
                auto &e = edges[graph[v][i]];
                int nxt = e.to;
                if (!visited[nxt] && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    dist[nxt] = dist[v] + 1;
                    q.push(nxt);
                    visited[nxt] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return visited[t];
    }

    long long sendFlow(int u, long long flow) {
        if (u == t || flow == 0) return flow;
        long long totalFlow = 0;
        for (int &i = current[u]; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            auto &e = edges[graph[u][i]];
            if (dist[u] + 1 == dist[e.to]) {
                long long pushed = sendFlow(e.to, min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edges[graph[u][i] ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
                    totalFlow += pushed;
                    flow -= pushed;
                    if (flow == 0) break;
                }
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    long long maxFlow() {
        long long total = 0;
        while (buildLevelGraph()) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 7100; ++i) current[i] = 0;
            total += sendFlow(s, LLONG_MAX);
        }
        return total;
    }
};
